detailed_description:
The target video is in an ethereal oriental aesthetic style, characterized by soft golden moonlit illumination, flowing clouds, and a cinematic, serene color palette. [Shot 1] At 00:00.000, the shot begins with a wide view of <Subject 3>, showing a brilliant full moon in the dark sky, as <Subject 1> floats gracefully through the clouds, her long white hanfu trailing behind her. The camera performs a slow push-in while <Subject 1> looks toward the moon. [Shot 2] At 00:02.000, the shot cuts to <Subject 1> traveling through a golden celestial gate into the palace, with soft light flowing around her as she moves horizontally across the frame. [Shot 3] At 00:04.000, the shot cuts to <Subject 2> resting on the palace floor under the giant moon; the camera performs a slow push-in toward the white tub. [Shot 4] At 00:06.000, the shot cuts to a side view of <Subject 1> reclining comfortably inside <Subject 2>, her eyes closed in relaxation, with soft flower petals floating on the water surface around her. The camera performs a slow side push-in. [Shot 5] At 00:09.000, the shot cuts to a macro detail of <Subject 2>, focusing on the water flowing from the faucet and the smooth curved lines of the tub's rim. The camera performs a slow micro push-in. [Shot 6] At 00:11.000, the shot cuts to a medium environment view showing <Subject 2> positioned centrally within <Subject 3>, emphasizing the harmonious blend of modern design and oriental aesthetics. The camera performs a slow arc shot around the setup. [Shot 7] At 00:13.000, the shot cuts to a final serene view of the moonlit palace environment, as the scene slowly fades to a calm black.

The soundscape features a continuous, soothing oriental instrumental melody featuring flute and zither, layered with gentle wind chimes and flowing water sound effects synchronized to the visuals.
